bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=$(docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format '{{.ID}}')
if [ -z "$cid" ] || [ "$(printf '%s\n' "$cid" | wc -l)" -ne 1 ]; then printf 'SINGLE_POLLER_NOT_CONFIRMED\n'; exit 72; fi
docker exec "$cid" node -e 'const fs=require("node:fs"),e=process.env;const p=e.VIDEOBOT_DATABASE_URL_FILE||e.VIDEOBOT_DB_PASSWORD_FILE;const o={ownerQueueEnabled:e.VIDEOBOT_OWNER_JOBS==="YES",connectionKind:e.VIDEOBOT_DATABASE_URL_FILE?"database_url":"database_password",mountPathValid:typeof p==="string"&&p.startsWith("/run/secrets/")};if(o.mountPathValid){try{const s=fs.statSync(p);Object.assign(o,{regularFile:s.isFile(),privateMode:(s.mode&63)===0,appSizeRange:s.size>=12&&s.size<=4096,genericSizeRange:s.size>=20&&s.size<=4096})}catch(err){o.statError=err.code||"UNKNOWN"}}console.log(JSON.stringify(o))'
